blocks.html:
The developed length of hot or tempered water piping, from the source of hot water to the fixtures that require hot or tempered water, shall not exceed 20 feet (6096 mm) or the maximum length in accordance with the New York City Energy Conservation Code. Recirculating system piping and heat-traced piping shall be considered to be sources of hot or tempered water.
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2009/085.
